questions.question: Visit the URL "https://127.0.0.1:8889/app/index.html#/search/all" and log in using the credentials: admin/password. After logging in, click on the circular symbol adjacent to "Client ID". Subsequently, select the displayed "Client ID" and click on "Collected". Initiate a new collection and gather artifacts labeled as "Windows.KapeFiles.Targets" using the _SANS_Triage configuration. Lastly, examine the collected artifacts and enter the name of the scheduled task that begins with 'A' and concludes with 'g' as your answer.
